CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xf789d.ticket_themes (theme STRING, ticket_count INT, example_ticket_id LONG);
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT ticket_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%bill%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%charge%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%charge%' THEN 'Billing'
      WHEN LOWER(subject) LIKE '%account%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%account%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%login%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%2fa%' THEN 'Account'
      WHEN LOWER(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%parcel%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%shipping%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%shipping%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%delivery%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%track%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%track%' THEN 'Shipping'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS theme
  FROM workspace.exam_xf789d.tickets
), agg AS (
  SELECT theme, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY theme
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE workspace.exam_xf789d.ticket_themes
SELECT theme, cnt, example_ticket_id
FROM agg
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 3;
